mapper.insert: INSERT INTO NOTIFICATION ( member_id, notification_type, notification_title, notification_content, related_id, is_read, is_important, is_deleted, created_at ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{notificationType}, #{notificationTitle}, #{notificationContent}, #{relatedId}, 'N', 'N', 'N', NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT notification_id AS notificationId, notification_type AS notificationType, notification_title AS notificationTitle, notification_content AS notificationContent, related_id AS relatedId, is_read AS isRead, is_important AS isImportant, DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(created_at, INTERVAL 9 HOUR), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt FROM NOTIFICATION WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND is_deleted = 'N' ORDER BY notification_id DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT notification_id AS notificationId, notification_type AS notificationType, notification_title AS notificationTitle, notification_content AS notificationContent, related_id AS relatedId, is_read AS isRead, is_important AS isImportant, is_deleted AS isDeleted, DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(created_at, INTERVAL 9 HOUR), '%Y.%m.%d %H:%i') AS createdAt FROM NOTIFICATION WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
AND is_deleted = 'Y'
AND is_deleted = 'N' AND is_important = 'Y'
AND is_deleted = 'N'
ORDER BY notification_id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN is_read = 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS unreadCount FROM NOTIFICATION WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND is_deleted = 'N'
mapper.update: UPDATE NOTIFICATION SET is_read = 'Y', read_at = IFNULL(read_at, NOW()) WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND is_deleted = 'N' AND is_read = 'N'
UPDATE NOTIFICATION SET is_deleted = 'Y' WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND is_deleted = 'N'
